An '''Artillery Weapon''' is a [[Weapon]] subtype (printed '''Weapon — Artillery'''). Artillery deploys at a site and is crewed rather than carried by a single warrior. Premiere has no artillery cards; they appear in later sets (for example Hoth).

Other weapon subtypes: [[Character Weapon]], [[Starship Weapon]], [[Automated Weapon]], [[Vehicle Weapon]].
